summary: Build practical microservices and Kubernetes skills through Docker, Helm, CI/CD, security, and observability labs. Enrol in TrainingCred training.
lede: Microservices architecture helps developers, architects, DevOps engineers, and platform engineers design services for Kubernetes deployment. The training addresses the practical work of turning application domains into independently deployable services, with practice mapping service boundaries, creating API contracts, and packaging applications in Docker. Learners also configure Kubernetes workloads and release workflows, then use metrics, traces, and dashboards to assess service health.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals moving from application development or infrastructure operations into containerized distributed systems. It supports a foundation-to-intermediate progression, with hands-on deployment work and conceptual treatment of advanced platform engineering topics.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of software development or infrastructure operations is expected. Familiarity with HTTP, REST APIs, Linux command-line navigation, and source control will support the practical labs. No previous Kubernetes administration experience is required. Coding is useful for service examples and test updates, but advanced programming is not required. Participants should have access to a laptop for guided container and Kubernetes exercises.
